pt.selectedTitle: 🎄 Luna Escolhe as Cores da Decoração! | Especial de Natal #5 #Shorts
pt.description: No quinto dia do nosso Especial de Natal, a adolescente Luna assume o papel de designer e escolhe a paleta de cores oficial para a decoração da Casa Azul! Venha ver como a família se diverte ajudando.

titleOptions: The Spitz Family Christmas Color Palette
en.selectedTitle: 🎄 Luna Chooses the Decor Colors! | Christmas Special #5 #Shorts
en.description: On the fifth day of our Christmas Special, teenage Luna takes over as designer and picks the official color palette for the Blue House decorations! See how the family helps out.

text.pt: Bem-vindos ao quinto dia do nosso especial, onde a magia das cores começa a brilhar.
text.en: Welcome to the fifth day of our special, where the magic of colors begins to shine.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 3D Pixar style, 9:16. A cute black Pomeranian dog (Luna) wearing round gold-rimmed glasses, a white pearl necklace, and a pink ruffled blouse. She is holding a color palette with gold and copper samples. Cozy blue house interior with warm Christmas lights.

text.pt: Este ano eu quero que nossa árvore seja a mais elegante e moderna de todas.
text.en: This year I want our tree to be the most elegant and modern of all.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 3D Pixar style, 9:16. A cream/white Pomeranian dog (Vlad) wearing thin round gold-rimmed glasses, a blue-and-white vertical striped button-down shirt, and a dark navy blue bow tie. He is looking curiously at Luna's color palette near a Christmas garland.

text.pt: Essas cores suaves combinam muito bem com o brilho das luzes que nós já desembaraçamos.
text.en: These soft colors match very well with the glow of the lights we already untangled.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 3D Pixar style, 9:16. A black Pomeranian dog (Raven) wearing round gold-rimmed glasses, a white pearl necklace, and a colorful floral print dress. She is smiling and nodding approvingly at Luna in a festive living room.

text.pt: Adorei a ideia, querida, o importante é que a nossa casa transmita todo esse carinho.
text.en: I loved the idea, honey, the important thing is that our home transmits all this affection.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 3D Pixar style, 9:16. A cream/orange Pomeranian dog (Theo) wearing rainbow multicolored frame glasses and a blue button-down shirt. He is holding a blue ornament and looking hopeful at his sister Luna.

text.pt: Será que podemos colocar alguns detalhes em azul para combinar com a minha nova camisa?
text.en: Can we put some blue details to match my new shirt for the big night?

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 3D Pixar style, 9:16. A small cream/golden Pomeranian dog (Jonny) with NO glasses, wearing a white button-down shirt and a dark bow tie. He is surrounded by jars of glitter and sparkling Christmas stars.

text.pt: Eu só quero que tudo brilhe muito e tenha bastante glitter por todos os lados.
text.en: I just want everything to shine a lot and have plenty of glitter everywhere.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 3D Pixar style, 9:16. Close up of the black Pomeranian dog (Luna) with her pink blouse and gold glasses. She is pointing to a beautiful copper ribbon. Warm holiday atmosphere in the background.

text.pt: Vamos usar tons de dourado e cobre para deixar a sala bem quente e muito aconchegante.
text.en: Let's use shades of gold and copper to make the living room warm and cozy.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 3D Pixar style, 9:16. The cream/white Pomeranian (Vlad) and the black Pomeranian (Luna) organizing boxes of ornaments together. Christmas tree in the background is partially decorated with lights.

text.pt: Parabéns pela escolha, Luna, agora vamos todos organizar as caixas com essas cores tão bonitas.
text.en: Congratulations on the choice, Luna, now let's all organize the boxes with these beautiful colors.

text.pt: O Natal da nossa família está ficando cada vez mais lindo e cheio de cores especiais.
text.en: Our family's Christmas is getting more and more beautiful and full of special colors.

en: A new holiday story every day!
